author: Priya
text: Our AWS bill hit $40k last month. I think we need to seriously look at alternatives. GCP's pricing looks a lot more predictable for our workload.

author: Marcus
text: I hear you on cost but AWS has way better support for our current Kubernetes setup. Switching clouds is a huge undertaking, not sure it's worth the risk right now.

author: Priya
text: Created ticket INFRA-101: Evaluate GCP migration feasibility. Priya assigned to investigate cost savings and migration complexity.

author: Priya
text: Finished the GCP cost analysis. We'd save roughly 30% annually. Sharing the doc in #infra-eng.

author: Marcus
text: 30% is compelling, I'll admit. My concern is still the migration effort for our stateful services. That's going to eat a lot of engineering time.

author: Alex
text: Late to this thread but I agree with Marcus on migration risk. Could we do a phased approach instead of a full cutover?

author: Priya
text: Opened PR #42: Proof-of-concept GCP deployment for the auth service, as a low-risk first migration candidate.

author: Marcus
text: The auth service PoC on GCP actually went smoother than I expected. I'm coming around on this. Still want to see how it holds up under real load though.

author: Alex
text: Updated INFRA-101: Auth service PoC passed load testing on GCP. Recommending phased migration starting Q3.

author: Marcus
text: Alright, I'm convinced. Let's move forward with the phased migration. Good work on the PoC, Priya.

author: Priya
text: Created INFRA-115: Migration plan for auth, billing, and notifications services to GCP, phased over Q3.

author: Alex
text: Kicking off the billing service migration this week. This one has more state to worry about than auth did.

author: Alex
text: Opened PR #58: Billing service GCP migration, including database replication strategy.

author: Marcus
text: Billing migration hit a snag with replication lag. Alex is investigating, might slip our Q3 timeline slightly.

author: Alex
text: Replication lag issue resolved by switching to a different sync strategy. Billing service migration back on track.

author: Priya
text: Closed INFRA-115: All three services (auth, billing, notifications) successfully migrated to GCP. Full cutover complete.

author: Marcus
text: Migration complete and stable for a week now. Genuinely glad we did this — the cost savings are already showing up.
